def clean(df):
    valid_species = df['species'].isin(['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'])
    valid_island = df['island'].isin(['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen'])
    valid_bill = (df['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (df['bill_length_mm'] <= 60)
    valid_flipper = (df['flipper_length_mm'] >= -198) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)
    valid_body = (df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)
    valid_sex = (df['sex'].notna()) & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))
    valid_rows = valid_species & valid_island & valid_bill & valid_flipper & valid_body & valid_sex
    return df[valid_rows]

def answer(df):
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {species: avg for species, avg in grouped.items()}
